reasons.plausibility: Complete replacement of Hf with V in a BCC RHEA is likely to destabilize the single-phase structure and drastically reduce high-temperature strength, contradicting known refractory alloy behavior.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes quantitative rejection criteria, but the hypothesis is so fundamentally flawed that the test is not scientifically meaningful.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes an intervention (full Hf replacement with V) that is almost certain to fail based on established principles, offering no viable path to the stated goal.
